PhaseImpedanceData.g.description: Conductance matrix element value, per length of unit.

PhaseImpedanceData.row.title: row
PhaseImpedanceData.row.description: The matrix element’s row number, in the range 1 to PerLengthPhaseImpedance.conductorCount. Only the lower triangle needs to be stored. This row number matches ACLineSegmentPhase.sequenceNumber.

PhaseImpedanceData.column.title: column
PhaseImpedanceData.column.description: The matrix element's column number, in the range 1 to row. Only the lower triangle needs to be stored. This column number matches ACLineSegmentPhase.sequenceNumber.

PhaseImpedanceData.b.title: b
PhaseImpedanceData.b.description: Susceptance matrix element value, per length of unit.

PhaseImpedanceData.r.title: r
PhaseImpedanceData.r.description: Resistance matrix element value, per length of unit.

PhaseImpedanceData.x.title: x
PhaseImpedanceData.x.description: Reactance matrix element value, per length of unit.

title: PhaseImpedanceData
description:
Impedance and conductance matrix element values. 
The diagonal elements are described by the elements having the same toPhase and fromPhase value and the off diagonal elements have different toPhase and fromPhase values.  The matrix can also be stored in symmetric lower triangular format using the row and column attributes, which map to ACLineSegmentPhase.sequenceNumber.
